display.summary: Operations panel polish: logs of every service, a lighter services table, a one-row admin rail.
highlights: Operations panel: services load on open; logs of every service, merged in time order, stay on screen (Composer 1.7.0b3+).
Services get icon actions with tooltips and an inline note for protected ones; a long deployment check starts as a two-line summary.
Operations is the first action in the admin rail, and the rail stays on one row while it fits.
Includes 1.13.0b2: the Operations panel. Includes 1.13.0b1: the maintenance page moves into the Composer image (stack schema 3).
